card.name: The end of "hypotension" in overdose lists
card.fires_on: The last piece of "hypotension" in the phrase "hypertension or hypotension", in lists of beta-agonist overdose signs and symptoms. Weaker on a few other list positions, such as after "hemorrhagic" or a comma in a drug list.

modes.label: hypertension or hypotension
modes.description: Final piece of "hypotension" in a list of stimulation symptoms just before "tachycardia".

modes.label: Other list joints
modes.description: Weaker firing on words or commas inside lists of strokes or drug names.

card.writes: It promotes line breaks and ellipsis marks, with no clear link to the next medical word.
card.plain: It fires at the end of "hypotension" when overdose symptoms are listed, such as seizures, angina and a fast heart rate.
